title: Miro board import contract (Issue #741)
description: The handoff format for the my-web-2026 planning board (board uXjVEZdqDp4=, 571 stickies / 583 connectors / 1 frame as counted via the ChatGPT Miro connection on 2026-11). This contract preserves the source's meaning: item id, text, position, parent frame, and connector endpoints are kept verbatim so the Issue cross-reference table can be generated without re-reading the board. Connectors are NOT assumed to be dependencies; stickies are NOT assumed to be approved work. Classification (implemented / partial / planned / deferred / rejected / unassessed / private) is a separate ledger decision recorded per item, never inferred from board geometry alone.

id.description: Stable Miro item id — the cross-reference key

text.description: Item text verbatim; may be empty for non-text items

parentFrameId.description: Frame the item sits in, if any

connectors.description: Connector endpoints reference item ids. A connector records adjacency on the board; it is NOT a dependency, priority, or approval signal.
